day_shape: 111 items: Iran and Israel announce halt to direct strikes after Trump pressure, IDF hits 9 Iranian air defence systems and Mahshahr petrochemical site, EU sanctions IRGC unit over Hormuz blockade, Hezbollah-Israel exchanges continue along Lebanon border.

threads.label: Iran-Israel ceasefire announcement
threads.summary: Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya command announced cessation of operations against Israel, with Israel saying the current round was behind it after Trump pressure. Times of Israel reported Home Front Command lifting most restrictions from 6am Tuesday, while Jerusalem Post reported communication lines with Khamenei's office disrupted since Sunday night.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Iranian targets
threads.summary: The IDF said dozens of fighter jets struck nine Iranian air defence systems in western and central Iran overnight, and hit infrastructure at the Mahshahr petrochemical complex. Iran International reported the Karoon Petrochemical complex was among the targets; Iran's aviation authority later said airspace had returned to normal.

threads.label: Hezbollah-Israel exchanges on Lebanon front
threads.summary: Hezbollah launched rockets at IDF troops in southern Lebanon triggering sirens in Kiryat Shmona and Zarit, while Israeli drone strikes hit a car in Tyre killing one. Defence Minister Katz said Israel would continue striking Beirut's Dahiyeh if Hezbollah attacks continue, with Smotrich reportedly proposing 20-30 buildings struck per Iranian missile.

threads.label: EU sanctions over Hormuz blockade
threads.summary: The EU added two Iranian individuals and one IRGC unit to its sanctions list over participation in the Strait of Hormuz blockade. IRIB framed the measures as imposed on the pretext of protecting freedom of navigation, while a former US ambassador said Oman's silence on cooperation with Iran had undermined its reputation.

threads.label: Iranian nuclear file and IAEA
threads.summary: IAEA chief Rafael Grossi urged Iran to re-engage with the watchdog and clarify the status of enriched uranium at sites bombed by the US and Israel, calling a diplomatic agreement the only solution. Iran's Atomic Energy Organisation head said units two and three of the Bushehr plant remain under construction.

threads.label: Iranian regime messaging on 'third imposed war'
threads.summary: Iranian state and IRGC-linked outlets ran heavy messaging framing recent strikes as 'Operation Victory', with Qalibaf claiming Iran had disrupted the ceasefire equation and Zolqadr warning of regional consequences. Defa Press and IRIB promoted the 'Tehran; Frontline of Resistance' photo exhibition and aired claims that the US plans to confiscate blocked Iranian funds.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Palestinian Islamic Jihad in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed a Saturday airstrike in central Gaza killed three senior Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives, including engineering chief Muhammad Abu Afash and his deputy Farhat Harara. Defa Press cited Gaza Health Ministry figures putting the death toll since October 2023 at 72,980.

Defence forces now release colour documentation of the destruction of one of these systems where missiles intended to target aircraft were stored.
